## Core Focus Areas & Interests

### 1. Autonomous Agents & Agentic Infrastructure
- Multi-agent fleet coordination, delegation architectures, and reactive communication.
- Agent harness design, dynamic execution loops, and practical tool-use environments.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server design, remote authenticated endpoints, and protocol integrations.
- Headless browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and multi-surface workflows.
- Evaluation of real-world model execution constraints, latency, reliability, and token economics.

### 2. Systems & High-Performance Engineering
- High-efficiency, low-footprint services and local utilities in Rust.
- Scalable backend architectures, API engineering, and distributed service design.
- Linux environment internals, containerization (Docker), local process harnesses, and shell automation.

### 3. Developer Platforms & Work Operating Systems
- Building tooling that eliminates developer friction and automates complex routine human workflows.
- Enterprise systems integrating employee lifecycles, project pods, attendance, and collaboration infrastructure.

### 4. Academic & Campus Infrastructure
- Building accessible platforms and MCP endpoints unlocking locked university ERP and LMS systems directly for AI assistants without central database overhead.

(https://kludesk.vercel.app | https://kled.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/KLU-DESK)

(https://gosynk.vercel.app | https://github.com/Lokkuchakreshkumar/gosynk)
